unique_information: PlayStat links playId, athleteId, statType, and stat, with game/period/clock context. This is finer player-to-play attribution than game or season aggregates.
not_supplied: The schema does not claim complete snap participation, all on-field athletes, or an as-of roster snapshot. Absence of a PlayStat row cannot establish nonparticipation or injury.

cheaper_alternatives./plays: play outcomes, timing, down, yards, score state, and PPA for F09 and team-driven F12
cheaper_alternatives./games/players: player game production and category statistics
cheaper_alternatives./stats/player/season: season-level player production for historical/offseason state only
cheaper_alternatives./player/usage: team season player usage aggregate; temporal validation required

gate: Sample first; verify stat meaning, coverage, and 2000-row cap handling; name concrete F10/F12 features uniquely enabled by this route; then choose full, subset, or skip based on incremental value, fresh-schedule calls, live quota, the 20000-attempt ledger, and storage. No Stage E calls in preparation.
cap_policy: A 2000-row response is suspected partial, never marked complete; subdivide by documented query filters or leave unavailable.
